title: More Useful Tables (Forge)
description: Hi there, this mod expand the workblock of villagers and per update we trying to make a table that is good and have a theme. This mod also available on Neoforge too
body:
Welcome to More Useful Tables (Forge). On this mod, add custom useful tables, the tables here is like Smithing Table etc. All tables have a function on it's own. each Update will contain a Workbenches block that is functional and is . The first update Tool Update have a block called Toolsmith Table that is use to create weapon and also needed toolsmith template for it. but there is no recipe book that u can see. So the recipe isn't available, the only way is to try or look on our discord. 



Available on Curseforge And Modrinth (You're Here)
